item.title: CVE-2026-120336 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was found in VStarcam O-KAM Client 1.3.3.32. Affected by this vulnerability is the function FUN_10003EA0 in the library DevDll_925.dll. The manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-120337 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was determined in VStarcam O-KAM SuperIPCam 1.3.3.32. Affected by this issue is the function FUN_005a2d44 of the file SuperIPCam.exe of the component P2P Session Teardown. This manipulation causes use after free. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-120339 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A security flaw has been discovered in mathurvishal CloudClassroom-PHP-Project. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file updatedetailsfromfaculty.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument fname results in cross site scripting.
